title: Roswell ignored until Berlitz's 1980 book

tellings.quote: Ros Roswell as an incident didn't become a thing until 1980 [snorts] when the litz wrote his book about it and then Stanton Freeman and others got involved

plain: The Roswell incident, the claim that a flying saucer crashed in New Mexico in 1947, is said to have been almost forgotten for more than thirty years, until the writer Charles Berlitz published his book The Roswell Incident in 1980. The skeptic Michael Shermer says this on the show, adding that the researcher Stanton Friedman "and others got involved" after the book. He tells it to suggest the story grew through later books, not from what happened in 1947.
